settings.text:
Tag @POPDARTSGAME on IG or TikTok with #POPDARTSWORLDRECORD hashtag.

*IMPORTANT* Email the link to Team@popdartsgame.com to submit your world record attempt for approval!

All world record video submissions must show the full successful attempt without ever leaving frame.

Below you will find each world record along with the parameters that must be followed in order to break the record.

settings.heading: longest t-nobber
settings.content:
Throw a Popdart and land the Popdart thrown on top of the Pro Target Marker.

• You must throw from at least 1 foot further away from the target than the previous record holder.

•Example: If the current world record is from 32FT then to break the record you must land a T-Nobber from at least 33FT away.

• You must immediately and clearly measure the distance between where the Popdart landed and the throwing location.

• This must be done on video as soon as the world record attempt has been successfully completed.

settings.heading: LONGEST THROW (Horizontal Surface)
settings.content:
Throw a Popdart and stick it to a horizontal surface within 12 inches of the Target Marker.

• You must throw from at least 1 foot further away from the target than the previous record holder.

•Example: If the current world record is from 32FT then to break the record you must land a Wigglenober from at least 33FT away.

• You must immediately and clearly measure the distance between where the Popdart landed and the throwing location.

• This must be done on video as soon as the world record attempt has been successfully completed.

settings.heading: LONGEST THROW (Vertical Surface)
settings.content:
Throw a Popdart and stick it to a vertical surface within 12 inches of the Target Marker.

• You must throw from at least 1 foot further away from the target than the previous record holder.

•Example: If the current world record is from 32FT then to break the record you must land a Wigglenober from at least 33FT away.

• You must immediately and clearly measure the distance between where the Popdart landed and the throwing location.

• This must be done on video as soon as the world record attempt has been successfully completed.

settings.heading: HIGHEST THROW
settings.content:
Throw a Popdart downward from an elevated area and stick the Popdart within 12 inches of the Target Marker.

• Your attempt must be at least 10 feet higher than the previous record holder.

Example: If the current world record is from 100FT, you must attempt from at least 110FT away.

• You must immediately and clearly show the distance between where the Popdart landed and the throwing location. This can be measured by building stories/floors. One floor is equal to 10 feet high.

• This must be done on video as soon as the world record attempt has been successfully completed.

settings.heading: HIGHEST THROWN WIGGLENOBBER
settings.content:
Throw a Popdart downward from an elevated area and land it on top of another designated Popdart.

• Your attempt must be at least 10 feet higher than the previous record holder.

Example: If the current world record is from 30FT, you must attempt from at least 40FT away.

• You must immediately and clearly show the distance between where the Popdart landed and the throwing location. This can be measured by building stories/floors. One floor is equal to 10 feet high.

• This must be done on video as soon as the world record attempt has been successfully completed.

settings.heading: MOST CONSECUTIVE STICKS FROM 15FT+
settings.content:
You must throw your Popdarts one at a time and consecutively stick them onto a 3FT X 3FT surface.

• Throw and stick 6 Popdarts in a row, remove them from the 3FT X 3FT surface, and repeat this cadence until a Popdart does not stick.

• If one Popdart does not stick, the count restarts.

• To count as a stick, the Popdart must be stuck down to the surface or be completely upright without resting on anything.

• Your attempt must be at least 1 stick more than the previous record holder.

Example: If the current world record is 226 sticks in a row, you must stick 227 in a row.

• This record attempt is time consuming so it can be submitted through a timelapse video.

settings.heading: MOST CONSECUTIVE STICKS FROM 15FT+ WITH A PARTNER
settings.content:
You must throw your Popdarts one at a time rotating back and forth between your partner and consecutively stick them onto a 3FT X 3FT surface.

• Throw and stick 6 Popdarts in a row (3 per partner), remove them from the 3FT X 3FT surface, and repeat this cadence until a Popdart does not stick.

• If one Popdart does not stick, the count restarts.

• To count as a stick, the Popdart must be stuck down to the surface or be completely upright without resting on anything.

• Your attempt must be at least 1 stick more than the previous record holder.

Example: If the current world record is 122 sticks in a row, you and your partner must stick 123 in a row.

• This record attempt is time consuming so it can be submitted through a timelapse video.

settings.heading: LONGEST THROWN WIGGLENOBBER
settings.content:
Throw a Popdart and land it on top of another designated Popdart.

• You must throw from at least 1 foot further away from the target than the previous record holder.

•Example: If the current world record is from 20FT then to break the record you must land a Wigglenober from at least 21FT away.

• You must immediately and clearly measure the distance between where the Popdart landed and the throwing location.

• This must be done on video as soon as the world record attempt has been successfully completed.

settings.heading: LONGEST BACKWARDS 3 POINT THROW
settings.content:
Throw a Popdart backwards and land it within the 3 point section on the board edition.

• You must throw at least 1 foot further away from the board than the previous record holder.

•Example: If the current world record is from 33FT then to break the record you must land a Wigglenober from at least 34FT away.

• You must immediately and clearly measure the distance between the front of the Popdarts Board Edition and the throwing location.

• This must be done on video as soon as the world record attempt has been successfully completed.
